responsibility: Implements the D front end’s lexical analyzer. It scans UTF-aware source buffers into `Token` objects, handles comments and Ddoc comment collection, string and numeric literal forms, token lookahead, `#line` directives, Unicode decoding, whitespace/newline tracking, and token buffering, providing the character-to-token stage consumed directly by the parser.
same_name_distinction: This `.c` file is the executable lexer implementation; unlike `lexer.h`, which declares the `Lexer` interface and state, it contains the token-scanning machinery itself, including character classification tables, comment/doc-comment handling, UTF decoding, lookahead support, and source-text to `Token` conversion.
